findings.body:
**Preserve exit code 3 for `needs-human`.**

If `options.live` returns `{ status: 'needs-human', reason: ... }`, Line 93 returns exit code 1. `LiveDispatch` explicitly permits this result. Map `needs-human` to 3 so callers can distinguish escalation from execution failure.

As per coding guidelines, “Exit codes: 0 clean, 1 thrown error, 2 arg error, 3 needs-human.”
findings.title: Preserve exit code 3 for `needs-human`.

findings.body:
**Replace watchdog state atomically.**

`writeFile` uses the default `w` flag, which truncates an existing file before writing. An interrupted write can therefore leave empty or partial JSON. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v22.x/api/fs.html))

The next invocation fails in `readState` at `src/queue-runner/watchdog.ts:119`. Every later invocation then returns before sending an alert, even after storage recovers. Operator intervention is required to restore watchdog operation.

Write a temporary file in the same directory, then rename it over `watchdog-state.json`. Apply the same change to the recovery write at Line 186.
findings.title: Replace watchdog state atomically.
Export `PlannerUsageError` from `runner.ts`. Without it, the `crq` CLI cannot load.
